senses.gloss:
Jiṣṇu(gupta)
of Bhillamāla family; father of Brahmagupta (a. of Khaṇḍakhādya, Rep. Hpr. 1895-1900, p. 11; Brahmasiddhānta, BBRAS. 250. Cambr. 43. IO. 2768). C.. J. nandana an. J. suta.

Jiṣṇudeva
tāntric teacher; grandson of Dīpakācārya; predecessor in the line of teachers of Śivānanda; mentioned by him in his Ṛjuvimarśinī on Nityāṣoḍaśikārṇava, Vārāṇaseya Skt. Uni. edn. p. 223; also on same p. in C. Artharatnāvalī on same text. Described by Śivānanda a. ‘Saṅketapuñja-prakāśaka’ which may or may not refer to a specific work.

Jiṣṇunandana
Q. by Jambunātha Mahābhāṣyabhaṭṭa Sundararāja in his C. Dīpikā on Vākyakaraṇa, MD. 13497. C.. Jiṣnu.

Jiṣṇusuta
Q. by Yallaya the commentator on Laghumānasa of Mañjulācārya a. Yantrajña, MD. 13475. C.. Jiṣṇu.
